mentions.name: gatewai.studio
mentions.description: An agentic workflow engine for content creators. It provides 40+ nodes for generating and modifying images, videos, audio, and vector graphics (including Crop, Resize, LUT extraction, Levels, Audio Compressor, Ken Burns, Mesh Warp, Recorder, Noise Gate, Compositor, and Signal Builder), and supports signals for dynamic and time-based configuration values, such as gradually changing blur strength in the first 2 seconds of a video. It renders with a WebGPU pipeline and a custom-built workflow processing engine, and is free to use except for the AI nodes and workflow agent.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on https://gatewai.studio in my free time - it is an agentic workflow engine for content creators.
